plan: Given my private value of $20, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while ensuring a win. Bidding exactly my value or higher risks no profit. Rational bidders will bid below their own values, anticipating the same from others. Thus, I will bid slightly below $20 to outbid others likely bidding below their values. This strategy balances winning the auction and maximizing profit.

Given my value of $23, the optimal strategy is to bid just below my value to maximize profit while ensuring a win. To win, I must outbid others without exceeding my value. Bidding slightly less than $23, say $22.9, maximizes my chances of winning and ensures a profit if the second-highest bid is lower. Since all bidders are rational, they will bid below their values, allowing me to win if their values are lower.

Given my value of $11, I should bid slightly below it to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Rational bidders will bid close to their own value. By bidding $10.9, I aim to win against values slightly below mine and pay less than my value. This minimizes the risk of overpaying while still providing a good chance of winning.
